stories.title: Trump escalates Iran sanctions; Tehran warns of prolonged conflict
new_facts: New story: US touted 'toughest sanctions ever' on Iran but experts say it fell short, fearing economic fallout.
Iran vows retaliation, warns US to 'expect an attack' after sanctions widened.
Oil drops 3% to 12-day low; Iran claims a two-year plan to cope with sanctions.
US sanctions target Chinese firms over Iran links while sparing major Chinese banks.
China warns Trump against 'economic warfare' via sanctions and threatens retaliation.
Names US Treasury secretary as source of threatened wide-ranging measures; China and Iran dismiss threats.
Pakistan's Asim Munir mediating to bring Iran back to nuclear/sanctions talks with US.
China explicitly warns it will take 'all necessary measures' if US expands its Iran sanctions crackdown.
Pakistani mediators report progress in Tehran talks on US-Israel-Iran war; Iran vows retaliation over new US sanctions
stories.line: Trump administration imposes broad new sanctions on Iran's economy; Iran promises retaliation and suggests prolonging conflict through Trump's term.

stories.title: U.S. and Canada enter tariff war as negotiations collapse
new_facts: Trump threatens to rename Lake Ontario amid trade war escalation.
Carney says Canada has leverage: 'We have what the world wants.'
Ford calls Trump a 'bully' and says Canada should 'throw everything and the kitchen sink' at him.
NYT reports US offered what it called the best deal of any country, but Canada saw required concessions as unthinkable.
Report identifies beef as a specific sticking point and notes Trump's inner circle sees no off-ramp yet.
Canada set to announce its retaliatory tariff response on August 25.
Carney personally withdrew from negotiations hours before the 50% tariffs deadline hit.
stories.line: Trump imposes tariffs on Canada; negotiations collapse as both sides prepare retaliatory measures.

stories.title: Study confirms CTE in at least 1 in 4 deceased NFL players
new_facts: At least 1 in 4 ex-NFL players who died 2016-2021 had CTE, far above general population rate
215 of 235 donated brains (of 878 deaths) showed CTE; diagnosis only possible post-mortem
stories.line: A study of deceased former NFL players found CTE in at least one in four, confirming long-suspected links between football and brain disease.

stories.title: Fitbit founders unveil new LTE health band launching in 2027
new_facts: Fitbit co-founders launch $250 Luffu Link LTE health/safety band, shipping early 2027
Device combines health sensing, voice logging, location tracking, trusted-contact alerts without a phone
stories.line: Fitbit founders announce a new wearable health device launching in early 2027 at $250.

stories.title: Tate's lawyers admit rented supercars in wealth imagery
new_facts: Prosecutors argue Tate brothers are flight risk, oppose bail; lawyers admit Tate exaggerates about supercars.
Lawyers say Tate rented supercars and borrowed a yacht in a Miami court filing; quote on 'business model'.
Specifies yacht's value at $50M and gives brothers' ages (Andrew 39, Tristan 38).
stories.line: Andrew Tate's legal defense admits he rented luxury cars for photos to project false wealth.

stories.title: Trump weighs new Iran sanctions amid doubt they'll shift behavior
new_facts: US imposes new Iran sanctions, calls them an "economic D-Day"; Tehran leaders expect to survive them.
Sanctions expanded to target Iran's crypto, gold, aviation and shipping networks.
stories.line: Trump administration considers new Iran sanctions; analysts dispute whether they'll change regime behavior or economics.

stories.title: Trump attacks Ford as trade tensions with Canada escalate
new_facts: Doug Ford calls Trump a 'dictator' and 'the king of bankruptcies'.
Publishes Trump's exact Truth Social quote threatening to rename Lake Ontario 'Lake America'.
Trump calls Doug Ford 'less intelligent' than his late brother Rob Ford amid tariff feud.
stories.line: Trump attacks Ontario's premier over trade tensions amid threatened tariffs on Canada.
